title: bug: the PowerShell VM taskless skip prints a second misleading idle reason (ps1 twin of task-1ccae85c)
description: Repro: verified-local seat, no task, a routed mention: moe-agent.ps1 prints MOE_TASKLESS_NO_LAUNCH reason=vm-route (the $script:MoeVmRoute block) and then reason=idle ('nothing to answer') from the if ($moeSkipLaunch) chain. Port its VR-taskless/VR-reload assertions to postflight-vm-route.ps1. Hand-forward: comment from architect-24611a0a on task-62ec51f1 (CQ-M07n).
